test.create_query: CREATE TABLE uniq_combined_large_states (g UInt32, s AggregateFunction(uniqCombined, UInt64), s64 AggregateFunction(uniqCombined64, UInt64)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY g
CREATE TABLE uniq_combined64_k12_states (s AggregateFunction(uniqCombined64(12), UInt64)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
CREATE TABLE uniq_combined_same_states (g UInt32, s AggregateFunction(uniqCombined, UInt64), s64 AggregateFunction(uniqCombined64, UInt64)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY g
CREATE TABLE uniq_combined64_k12_same_states (s AggregateFunction(uniqCombined64(12), UInt64)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO uniq_combined_large_states SELECT intDiv(number, 20000) % 50 AS g, uniqCombinedState(number), uniqCombined64State(number) FROM numbers(20000000) GROUP BY intDiv(number, 20000)
INSERT INTO uniq_combined64_k12_states SELECT uniqCombined64State(12)(number) FROM numbers(30000000) GROUP BY intDiv(number, 300)

INSERT INTO uniq_combined_same_states SELECT intDiv(number, 20000) % 50 AS g, uniqCombinedState(toUInt64(number % 20000)), uniqCombined64State(toUInt64(number % 20000)) FROM numbers(20000000) GROUP BY intDiv(number, 20000)
INSERT INTO uniq_combined64_k12_same_states SELECT uniqCombined64State(12)(toUInt64(number % 300)) FROM numbers(30000000) GROUP BY intDiv(number, 300)
